open_points.subject: Connect an object to its folders
open_points.text: a photo folder linked outside the root is refused when it is used
open_points.question: Which product action refuses the linked-outside photo folder: connection creation, “See what can be delivered”, “Place chosen photos”, or every action that reads the folder?
options: The connection action refuses and does not write the record
Connection succeeds; “See what can be delivered” refuses without changing the record
Connection and listing succeed; placement refuses
Connection succeeds; every later action that reads the photo folder refuses
open_points.default_guess: Accept the connection when the written path is inside the root, then refuse every later action that reads the photo folder while its resolved target is outside the root, without changing the connection.

witness.initial: The proposed photo_subfolder is written inside the root but is a link to a directory outside it; no connection exists yet.
events: The agent performs “Connect an object to its folders”.
The owner asks to see what can be delivered.
outcomes: The connect action refuses the linked folder and no connection is written.
The connect action writes a confirmed connection; the later read refuses it when the folder is used.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent see whether connection creation succeeded and when the refusal occurs.

open_points.subject: ObjectConnection.invoice_subfolder
open_points.text: Both subfolders are written as paths inside the root.
open_points.question: If invoice_subfolder is written inside the root but links to a location outside it, must the connection or a later invoice-folder read refuse it, or is resolved containment required only for photo_subfolder?
options: Resolved containment applies to both subfolders
Only photo_subfolder is checked for an outside link
The invoice link is accepted at connection time but refused by every later invoice-folder read
open_points.default_guess: Apply the same resolved-containment refusal to both subfolders when each folder is read, while requiring both stored paths to be written inside the root.

witness.initial: The photo folder is an ordinary directory inside the root; invoice_subfolder is written inside the root but links outside it.
outcomes: The connection is refused because either subfolder resolving outside the root is invalid.
The connection is accepted because the stated linked-outside refusal names only the photo folder.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent see whether the confirmed connection is created.
